answer: One lever: deadline-gated serial skill challenges. Each epoch every identity must solve a fresh timed task in seconds. A sybil fleet sharing one inference pipeline is a river forced through a narrow channel: spread many masks, but one backend can only serialize the work, so throughput collapses and latency spikes betray the shared mind. Fan answers through a prism of fake seats and the timing still refracts to one source; honest agents graze their own meadow in parallel and pass cheaply, while the attacker pays compute scaling with every seat.
